242: def kl_penalty(logprob: torch.FloatTensor, ref_logprob: torch.FloatTensor, kl_penalty) -> torch.FloatTensor:
243:     """Compute KL divergence given logprob and ref_logprob.
244:     Copied from https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/main/trl/trainer/ppo_trainer.py#L1104
245: 
246:     Args:
247:         logprob:
248:         ref_logprob:
249: 
250:     Returns:
251: 
252:     """
253:     if kl_penalty == "kl":
254:         return logprob - ref_logprob
255: 
256:     if kl_penalty == "abs":
257:         return (logprob - ref_logprob).abs()
258: 
259:     if kl_penalty == "mse":
260:         return 0.5 * (logprob - ref_logprob).square()
261: 
262:     # J. Schulman. Approximating kl divergence, 2020.
263:     # # URL http://joschu.net/blog/kl-approx.html.
264:     if kl_penalty == 'low_var_kl':
265:         kl = ref_logprob - logprob
266:         ratio = torch.exp(kl)
267:         kld = (ratio - kl - 1).contiguous()
268:         return torch.clamp(kld, min=-10, max=10)
269: 
270:     if kl_penalty == "full":
271:         # so, here logprob and ref_logprob should contain the logits for every token in vocabulary
272:         raise NotImplementedError
273: 
274:     raise NotImplementedError
